Dear Mr. Robb:
Subject: Review of Randolph Urban Renewal Project Draft Environmental Statement to prepare your proposed Response to the Department of Housing and Urban Development
This project was reviewed by the Office of Comprehensive Health Planning together with the Division of Sanitary Engineering, the Bureau of Environmental Health,
and the Richmond City Health Department. The draft statement was found to be acceptable in its present form.
It appears that the objectives of the Randolph project are consistent with the objectives of the Richmond City Health Department Housing Program and would supplement the efforts of that Department.
The Virginia State Health Department is therefore pleased to endorse the Randolph Urban Renewal Project and recommends that it be approved.
Sincerely,
Mack I. Shanholtz, M.D.
State Health Commissioner
